def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    # lru_dict maintains insertion order; most recently used at the end
    lru_dict = OrderedDict()
    # write_time maps key to the time it was written
    write_time = {}
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, wt in write_time.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del lru_dict[k]
                del write_time[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it to re-insert at the end
            if key in lru_dict:
                del lru_dict[key]
            # If adding a new key and cache is full, evict LRU
            elif len(lru_dict) >= capacity:
                lru_key, _ = lru_dict.popitem(last=False)
                del write_time[lru_key]
            
            # Add the new entry
            lru_dict[key] = value
            write_time[key] = t
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, wt in write_time.items() if wt + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del lru_dict[k]
                del write_time[k]
            
            # Check if key exists
            if key in lru_dict:
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                lru_dict.move_to_end(key)
                results.append(lru_dict[key])
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
